claims.content: To view and verify the status of claims submitted by a Voucher Service Provider (VSP).

goal.raw_text: To view and verify the status of claims submitted by a Voucher Service Provider (VSP).

claims.content: VMU User
The VMU system must be operational and accessible to the VMU User.
The VMU User must be logged into the system with appropriate security privileges that allow access to claim status information.
At least one Voucher Service Provider (VSP) must have submitted a claim (Treatment Form) to the MSIU Field office, and this claim data must have been entered into the VMU database.
The VMU User selects a specific Voucher Service Provider (VSP) to view their claim status.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User selects a specific Voucher Service Provider (VSP) to view their claim status.

claims.content: The VMU User selects a specific Voucher Service Provider (VSP) from the system interface.
The system retrieves and displays the master information of the selected VSP, including their name, code, and contact details.
The system provides an option or screen element for the user to view the 'Claim Status' of the selected VSP.
The VMU User initiates the request to view the claim status details.
The system queries the database for all claims associated with the selected VSP.
The system displays a list of claims for the VSP, showing key details for each claim such as Claim No, Date, Amount, Status, and Remarks.
The VMU User reviews the displayed claim statuses to verify processing, payment, or rejection reasons.

The system checks for duplicate VSP names during creation or modification. If a duplicate name is found, the system generates a warning message with options to 'Continue' (Yes/No). If the user selects 'Yes', the system allows the entry to be saved; if 'No', the system prevents saving the new entry.
If the system detects more than two fraud entries associated with a particular VSP during the claim process, the system automatically changes the status of that specific VSP to 'In-activate'.

During claim submission, if the number of forms mentioned does not match the number of available forms in the system, the system flags this discrepancy. Additionally, if mandatory information is missing or false data is detected in a claim, the claim status is changed to 'Rejected' or placed in a 'Quarantine' area, and the system prompts for a reason code.

If a thumb impression captured from a claim form mismatches with previous visits for the same patient (Client/Partner) on the same voucher number, the system automatically increments a mismatch count. If the same VSP has more than two thumb impression mismatches, the system produces a warning message and automatically inactivates the VSP.
If the selected Voucher Service Provider (VSP) has no claims submitted or recorded in the system, the system displays a message indicating 'No claims found' and exits the use case.

If the VMU User attempts to view claim status for a VSP that is currently marked as 'In-Active' due to fraud detection or thumb impression mismatch rules, the system displays a warning notification stating the VSP is inactive before showing any historical claim data, then exits.
If the database query for claim status fails or times out, the system displays an error message 'Unable to retrieve claim data' and terminates the process.
